name: ndreyer
description: A young man of 23, 189 cm, LEAN and narrow-shouldered, a long neck, long legs, not muscular. Fair, warm, lightly sun-kissed skin, a few freckles across the nose. Warm honey-golden dark-blond hair with some depth, side-swept with product, a cowlick whorl at the crown that still sticks up. Medium blue eyes, visible golden-brown brows and lashes, a narrow face. A WIDE GAP BETWEEN HIS UPPER FRONT TEETH that shows whenever he smiles. OUTFIT (the rooftop party): a long-sleeved technician-cut shirt in soft pastel apricot-peach with a small stand collar, a high fastened placket with BLACK buttons, seam-tape bars over both shoulders and down the outside of both sleeves, a square chest pocket on his left chest with no badge - the bars, the placket and the pocket in a slightly DARKER PEACH than the shirt, tone on tone; black buttons at the cuffs; a black leather belt with a silver buckle; straight black trousers with a crease; polished black leather derby shoes, never sneakers. BOTH HANDS EMPTY in every view unless the pose itself uses them: nothing held, no props. No jewellery, no watch, no glasses, no tattoos. PRONOUNS: the view library's prompts say 'she/her'; this character is a MAN - every view must be drawn as him (see _next_session).
